summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of 287,211 of its own ordinary shares (5p each) from J.P. Morgan Securities plc on 24 April 2026. Prices ranged from 11.12 to 11.3350 GBP, with an average of 11.2041 GBP. The shares were bought under shareholder authority from the 2025 AGM via an on-exchange arrangement announced 6 January 2026. Repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing share count to 2,522,120,122. This is a routine capital return via a share buyback, not an issuer tender offer.
